role: Milwaukee County Highway Commissioner and Director of Public Works
stance_basis: paraphrase states County Board took official action incorporating Airport Spur into freeway system and pledged county funds; letter praises the Draft EIS and supports Alternate #5
summary: H. B. Wildschut, Milwaukee County Highway Commissioner and Director of Public Works, expressed strong support for the Airport Spur project at the 1969 public hearing, noting the County Board had officially incorporated it into the county freeway system and pledged funds. He also submitted a written comment on the Draft EIS in July 1973, praising the statement's quality while noting two omissions (the Howell Avenue access addition and the transit plan connection), and affirming that Alternate #5 offers the least disruptive connection with minimal adverse environmental impacts.
complaint_summary: Wildschut's July 1973 letter praised the Draft EIS as well-prepared but identified two omissions: (1) the facility had been changed to provide access to Howell Avenue per County Board action, and (2) the Airport Spur's role as an integral part of the Milwaukee Area Transit Plan had not been included; the letter also endorsed Alternate #5 as the least disruptive option with minimal adverse environmental impacts.

statement.text:
Thank you for the opportunity to review the Draft Environmental Statement for the Airport Spur.
The statement offers an excellent description of the project and its alternatives. It also is complete in its description of the need for the project and the service it will provide Mitchell Field.
The statement is well prepared and documented with respect to the assessment of impact to the environment in the areas of air and noise pollution.
Two notable omissions in the statement are:
1. The facility while considered as an exclusive connection to the airport has since been changed to provide access to Howell Avenue. This was done at the request of the County Board on November 21, 1972, and approved by the State and Federal Highway Administration on March 13, 1973.
2. The Airport Spur is an integral part of the Milwaukee Area Transit Plan adopted by the County Board on May 8, 1973. It would be a vital link in multi-mode service for the airport area.
COURTHOUSE ANNEX, ROOM 411 . 901 NORTH 9TH STREET . MILWAUKEE, WISCONSIN 53233 . TELEPHONE 278-4872
GLENN H JACOBSON Real Estate Administrator
DONALD D LEAMAN Asst Expressway Engineer
6933

The Commission has actively participated in the development of the Airport Spur and feels that Alternate #5 offers the least disruptive connection to the airport with minimal adverse environmental impacts.
Sincerely,
MILWAUKEE COUNTY EXPRESSWAY AND TRANSPORTATION COMMISSION
George'J.

Also stated that the County Board has approved the Master Plan for the expansion of General Mitchell Field's airport terminal and air cargo area.
